# ReeeeecallStudy

> ReeeeecallStudy is a flashcard learning platform with spaced repetition (SRS), six study modes, AI-assisted learning, deck sharing, and progress statistics. You can start with a free plan; paid plans increase card storage limits.

## Product

- Six study modes: SRS, sequential review, random, sequential, by date, and cramming.
- SRS recall ratings: Again, Hard, Good, and Easy. Review timing adapts to each card's learning history.
- AI card generation creates templates, decks, and cards from a topic. AI quizzes and grading are separate features.
- AI features have a daily free allowance. Usage beyond that allowance uses prepaid balance; the charge is shown before confirmation.
- Deck sharing supports Copy, Subscribe, and Snapshot. Public deck previews can be read without an account.
- The free plan has a card storage limit. Paid plans increase it. Current prices, limits, and available plans appear on the landing page; they can change.
- The interface supports English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Vietnamese, Thai, and Indonesian.
- New Learning Insights articles are published in English and Korean. Some older articles remain available in other languages.
